What is Leonardo.Ai?

Image generation platform aimed at game development and production art, offering fine-grained control through custom model training, ControlNet-style guidance, and a real-time canvas. Acquired by Canva in 2024.

Best for

Consistent, style-controlled asset generation for games and production art.

Main features

  • Custom model training on your own image sets (Elements and finetuned models)
  • Image Guidance (ControlNet - pose, depth, edge, sketch)
  • Realtime Canvas and Realtime Gen for live iteration
  • AI Canvas with inpainting and outpainting
  • Motion for image-to-video
  • texture generation for 3D models
  • Universal Upscaler
  • Prompt Magic
  • large community model library
  • Alchemy rendering pipeline.

Practical use cases

  • Training a model on your game's art style and generating consistent assets
  • producing game textures and tilesets
  • pose-guided character illustration
  • iterating in real time on a composition
  • upscaling assets to production resolution.

Who is it for?

  • Game artists, concept artists, indie studios, 3D and texture artists, and designers who need control over style consistency.

Pricing, free access & limits

Freemium token-based subscription

Plans described in the source

Free with roughly 150 daily tokens (resets daily). Apprentice around $12/mo ($10 annually, roughly 8,500 tokens/month). Artisan around $30/mo ($24 annually, roughly 25,000 tokens plus relaxed generation). Maestro around $60/mo ($48 annually, roughly 60,000 tokens). Teams and API pricing separate. Annual billing roughly 20% cheaper.

Free plan

Yes - genuinely useful free tier with daily token refresh, the most generous free access among premium generators here.

Free trial

The free daily token allowance serves as an ongoing trial.

Usage limits to consider

Token-metered per generation, with higher resolution, Alchemy pipeline, upscaling and video costing substantially more tokens. Free tier tokens reset daily but are quickly consumed by high-quality settings. Custom model training consumes a large token block.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • The deepest control toolkit of any consumer generator - ControlNet guidance plus custom model training means real style consistency, which matters enormously for game asset pipelines
  • daily-refreshing free tier is the most generous here
  • strong community model library
  • a proper API unlike Midjourney.

Limitations to consider

  • Token accounting is complex and high-quality settings drain it quickly
  • the interface is cluttered with options that overwhelm newcomers
  • base output quality is a notch below Midjourney for pure aesthetics
  • the Canva acquisition creates uncertainty about long-term independent direction
  • custom model training requires meaningful effort and a good dataset.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web, iOS, Android
  • API

Languages

  • English prompts; interface English

API access

Yes - Leonardo API with production and enterprise tiers, priced per generation

Integrations and exports

  • Canva (since acquisition), API
  • community model sharing

Evaluation notes

Custom model training is the feature that justifies Leonardo over cheaper alternatives - if you will not train models, Ideogram or Midjourney give better output per dollar. Test token consumption at your intended quality settings before choosing a tier.
